title: Manhattan Marvel & Science Family Trip
summary: A two-day trip in Manhattan for a father and his 12-year-old son who love Marvel movies, Spider-Man, the New York Knicks, science, and Percy Jackson. The itinerary blends superhero-themed sights, science museums, Knicks landmarks, and family-friendly parks with halal meals and convenient prayer stops.
